While PRIDE metadata lists 'Top-down proteomics' in experimentTypes, the Methods section explicitly describes a bottom-up workflow (trypsin digestion, peptide enrichment, and nanoLC-MS/MS). I have prioritized the detailed Methods text over the PRIDE metadata tag. The SNOTRAP method is used for specific enrichment of S-nitrosylated cysteines.

scope: SNOTRAP selectively converts SNO to a stable disulfide-iminophosphorane in the SNO protein, followed by trypsin digestion. Then, the tryptic peptides are enriched on streptavidin agarose beads.
